issue_title: Product Page v2 does not work with all input types.
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

following the instructions on how to add fields to product page v2
https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/8/modules/sample-modules/extend-product-page/

adding a EntitySearchInputType to the options tab
https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/8/development/components/form/types-reference/entity-search-input-type/

ends up in rendering a dead input that does not work to search in, also the delete buttons for attached items does nothing.

Seems to be related to the search for related products is initiated with hard coded id's in https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/a85f47c37b3e3b52a4eddbdcb33baf851d0dd691/admin-dev/themes/new-theme/js/pages/product/product-map.ts

```
 relatedProducts: {
    searchInput: '#product_description_related_products',
  },
```


rebuilding this file with a class selector does make the input search, but the two widgets will then overlap and adding a new item will be added to both inputs. So there seems to be more issues with this.


### Expected behavior

I expect inputTypes to work.

### Steps to reproduce

1. install a module to the shop that extends the product page with a EntitySearchInputType 
2. select product page v2
3. go to a product
4. type a search into the new field.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.1.2

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.4.9

issue_title: New Product Page vs. Old product page; maxchar for meta title and description
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

_Old product page:_ maximum characters for meta title and meta description is 70 and 160 chars. Although **more characters can be saved** when old product page is used. The table accepts 128 characters for meta title and 512 characters for meta description. 

_New Product Page:_ maximum characters for meta title and meta description is 70 and 160 chars. **Saving page with more characters can't not be done** and **information is showing under the form informing than only 70/160 characters can be used**.

The different behaviours of those two pages, old vs. new, is complicating updating products in the future. When using old page, longer titles and longer desctiptions can be saved. Those longer titles and desctiptions can be showed in the New Product Page, but then the product can't be updated with other info, unless the title and description has been decreased to 70/160 characters.

For some older shop owners this will complictate things, they will have to update all meta titles and description in order to use the New Product Page, just to be able to update simple things like stock amount.

This change in the New PRoduct Page will be a massive problems for many updated shop and owners.

Should it be better if the **product can be saved anyway**, but **with warning text that recommendation** is that meta title should be maximum 70 chars and meta description 160 chars? 

### Expected behavior
x the number of characters in the field.

- for the meta_title

Display on the bottom of the field : "x of 70 characters used (recommended)"
Validation server: 255 characters, like on the previous page.

- for the meta_description

Display on the bottom of the field : "x of 160 characters used (recommended)"
Validation server: 512 characters, like on the previous page.

### Steps to reproduce

Swithing between old and new product page, shows clearly what can be saved.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.1.0, 8.1.2

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.4

title: Add message when duplicating product
issue_title: Duplicating a product duplicates the SEO content
issue_body:
#### Is your feature request related to a problem?

When a duplicate a product, it duplicates as well the meta-title, the meta-description and the friendly URL in the SEO tab. So it creates duplicated content which is bad for the SEO if the merchant does not notice it.

#### Describe the solution you'd like

The solution still needs to be discussed but here are the following ideas:
- Add in BO a warning/tip message to explain that different meta's are needed for each product.
- Add warning on the duplication actions to be careful with the SEO product content.
- Empty the SEO fields on the duplication
